text:
elaine (AE): Quick sync — prospect (GlobalBank) wants a short POC next month. Main decision: Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private. They care about EU data residency, KMS, and <100ms p95 for query autocomplete use case. Can we map options + rough lead times/pricing?
samir (Solutions): Quick notes: Hosted = fastest (days), Dedicated = weeks (reserve GPUs), Private = months (on-prem/VPC & legal). EU region available for hosted and dedicated. KMS support: hosted supports customer-managed keys (KMS) via integration; private = full control.
nate (Eng): For <100ms p95 across autocomplete we need model + lighter context (<=128 tokens). On g4dn-like infra hosted in eu-west latency should be okay; for guaranteed latency, Dedicated with reserved pool is safer.
priya (Security): Security checklist: SOC2, encrypted at rest, CMK support, network isolation for Private. They asked for a filled security questionnaire — I can take ownership if you share Qs. Also need to confirm logging retention and audit export options.
marco (SE): Proposed POC acceptance criteria (draft):
- Latency: p95 < 120ms (target 100ms) for 128-token autocomplete
- Quality: top-3 suggestions match human baseline on 90% of eval prompts
- Throughput: sustained 200 qps for peak window
- Security: KMS in-place, encryption in transit + at rest
- Integration: webhook + incremental KV cache working
(we can tighten after initial run)
lydia (CS): Timeline idea: kickoff week 1, deploy test harness week 2, run 3-day load & eval week 3, handoff week 4. Prospect budget prefers 2-4 week POC.
elaine (AE): Pricing question from buyer: what's delta between Hosted pay-as-you-go vs Dedicated monthly commit? They want ballpark for 200 qps sustained for 4 weeks.
samir (Solutions): Ballpark: Hosted usage ~ pay-per-token + compute — for 200 qps peak and short contexts estimate ~ 10-15k USD/week. Dedicated reserved small pool (1–2 nodes) ~ 25–40k/month depending on GPU. Give me exact numbers and I'll send an estimate.
priya (Security): Also note: if they require customer-managed HSM-backed keys, Hosted supports KMS but some HSM integrations need Dedicated/Private. Need to confirm supplier KMS provider.
nate (Eng): Ops note: if we choose Dedicated, we need 2–3 week lead time to provision eu-west capacity and run conformance tests. Private on-prem will add legal + network setup (4–8 weeks).
marco (SE): For the security questionnaire, I'll attach a short config snippet they can use to validate KMS + region routing:
```
routing:
  preferred_region: eu-west-1
  fallback: hosted-global
kms:
  provider: aws-kms
  key_id: arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456:key/xxx
```
lydia (CS): Customer success will run evaluation harness and provide prompt set. Need their acceptance sample (50 seed prompts) and success thresholds signed off.
elaine (AE): Action items: 1) samir to send pricing ballpark by EOD, 2) priya to list questionnaire owner + known gaps, 3) nate to confirm provisioning lead times, 4) marco to draft POC acceptance doc and sample eval prompt list.
marco (SE): Will do. Draft POC acceptance doc and sample prompts by tomorrow noon.
priya (Security): I'll take the security questionnaire — please route the doc to me and I'll flag any blockers within 48h.
samir (Solutions): Sending price ranges now, ping me if buyer asks for committed-term discounts.
infra-bot: Provisioning ETA check: eu-west reserved pool current capacity available in 10 business days.
elaine (AE): Great — I'll update the buyer with the timeline and ask for the 50 seed prompts + security questionnaire. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
marco (SE): small follow-up: if they insist on <100ms p95 as hard SLA we should push Dedicated + local routing. I'll note that in the POC doc.
elaine (AE): noted — will highlight tradeoff.
lydia (CS): I'll prep onboarding checklist for the prospect so they can prepare API keys, VPC info (if Private), and sample data.
elaine (AE): Perfect. Closing this thread once POC doc is in.
